messages:
incident-bot: Pager — SEV_HIGH triggered: sharp increase in 5xx responses (502/504) at API gateway starting ~15:03 UTC. Primary signal: api-gw.edge.prod -> /v1/generate. Affected region: us-west-2. Paging @oncall-sre. Link: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashboards/alerts/6712349999

oncall-sre: On it, joining. First check: are edge pods healthy?

sre_sam: I see spike in 502s from the edge multiplexers -> backend pool. 502 rate ~65% for last 2m, overall p95 latency up.

eng_runtime_maya: Looking at runtime traces — many connections to model-backend-io are returning TLS handshake errors then 502 from the gateway.

netops_jules: On the infra side, we're seeing increased RSTs from the upstream NLB (us-west-2). Could be a connection exhaustion.

support_ian: Customer impact: a handful of requests for paid tenants failing. Tickets already opened by two customers on EU region (they're routed via us-west for some traffic).

oncall-sre: Quick mitigations: 1) enable fallback to warm pool model variant 2) temporarily increase connection pool to backends 3) enable short-circuit for /v1/embeddings paths to secondary cluster. Which is fastest to flip?

sre_sam: I can flip pool resizing now (control plane). Doing: 
```
redwoodctl backend scale --pool model-backend-io --min 50 --max 200
```
Scaling command issued, monitoring.

eng_runtime_maya: Also pushing a short config to gateway to reduce keepalive to 30s and reduce max concurrent per upstream from 500 -> 250 (to avoid head-of-line). Patch: 
```json
{"gateway.keepalive_ms":30000, "upstream.max_conn":250}
```
Applying now.

netops_jules: I can toggle NLB connection drain settings and bump target group healthy threshold. Doing a gentle drain on the most overloaded targets.

incident-bot: Incident runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/gw-5xx-echo. Set status to "mitigating" if actions in flight.

support_ian: Sending customer acknowledgement messages. Share ETA when we have 10min visibility.

product_lina: Any observed regressions from the latest routing change rollout? We rolled mux v2 yesterday evening. Could this be related?

eng_runtime_maya: Mux v2 shows slight increase in multiplexing concurrency. But the signature here looks like backend process exhaustion rather than mux bugs. Correlating: backend memory/FDs spiked ~14:58 UTC.

oncall-sre: Sam confirm: did the scale command increase healthy backend count?

sre_sam: Backend pool increased from 18 -> 62 instances within ~90s. Error ratio briefly dropped to 20% then climbed back to ~40%.

netops_jules: After draining the hottest targets, RSTs reduced by ~50%. Still seeing transient 502s from a subset of edge nodes.

eng_runtime_maya: Captured sample request trace:
```
edge -> gw-proxy-17 -> model-backend-io-3: TLS handshake failed: no shared ciphers
edge returns 502 to client
```
Suggests a TLS config mismatch or an upstream process restarting mid-handshake.

oncall-sre: OK shift: disable mux v2 half of traffic (traffic-split 50/50) to see if stable. Anyone able to flip traffic-split?

eng_runtime_maya: I can flip the weighted routing in 2m. Preparing rollout (will do canary 10% -> 50%).

incident-bot: Note: pager duty escalation will trigger if SLO breach >15m. Current breach duration: 9m.

support_ian: Customer impact note: Support queue has 7 high-priority inbound reports. Preparing incident bulletin for accounts team.

product_lina: If traffic-split helps, we should rollback mux v2 rollout. Keep me updated.

eng_runtime_maya: Canary started: shifting 10% -> 50% away from mux v2 for generate endpoints.

sre_sam: Error rate down to 18% after weighted rollback to 50/50. Keep watching.

netops_jules: NLB metrics steadying. I'll continue draining 4 targets that still show high retried connections.

oncall-sre: Good. Current plan: keep backend scaled, keep mux split at 50/50, continue target drain. If error rate <5% for 10m, mark mitigated and start recovery steps.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigating. Time logged: 15:20 UTC.

support_ian: Sending interim customer bulletin: "We're investigating elevated errors for API requests in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress. Will update in 10 minutes."

product_lina: Documenting impact: potential latency spike for embeddings and generation. Assigning postmortem owner: eng_runtime_maya.

eng_runtime_maya: Got it — will capture traces, diffs from yesterday's mux v2 rollout, and backend cluster health.

sre_sam: Monitoring window: 15:20 -> 15:40. If stable at <5% for 10 consecutive minutes, we'll close pager and file RCA.

netops_jules: Final note: watch for re-introduction when we re-enable full mux v2 traffic. I'd recommend a slower ramp and connection validation pre-check.

incident-bot: Next update reminder scheduled in 9 minutes.
